title: Drift-O-Meter Build Board
summary: Building an Expo/React Native iPhone app that judges real-world drifting from the gyroscope, accelerometer and GPS, with NFS / Tokyo Drift-grade presentation. Each piece is built by one agent and judged by a separate fresh-context critic against the running app, real sensor output and finished visualisations.
verification: This build machine is Linux: it cannot compile or run the iOS binary. The engine is pure TypeScript and is exercised by tests against a physics simulator with ground truth.
The UI is the real app bundle, built for web, run in Chromium and screenshotted by the harness; critics judge those screenshots and videos, never the builder's summary.
What only a phone can verify (real CoreMotion units, haptics, 100 Hz timing, GPS latency in the field) is listed as on-device checks in the final hand-off.

pieces.name: Sensor simulator
pieces.note: Kinematic drift driver on two tracks, phone-mount model, gyro bias, vibration, GPS latency/noise, ground truth

pieces.name: Mount calibration
pieces.note: Phone frame → vehicle frame from gravity and forward acceleration

pieces.name: Slip-angle estimator
pieces.note: Kalman fusion of gyro heading, lateral-g kinematics and GPS course

pieces.name: Drift detection
pieces.note: Entry / sustain / transition / exit state machine

pieces.name: Scoring & style
pieces.note: Angle × duration × speed, multipliers, callouts, S–D grade, consistency

pieces.name: Track & laps
pieces.note: GPS → local map, lap gate, corners, lap-to-lap consistency

pieces.name: Signal integrity
pieces.note: Loose-mount detection, physics plausibility, GPS quality gating

pieces.name: Replay scene
pieces.note: Session → timeline, glow trail, camera, ghost

pieces.name: App foundation
pieces.note: Theme, fonts, navigation, Skia on web, sensor adapters, screenshot harness

pieces.name: Live drive HUD
pieces.note: Angle, g-meter, speed, score combo, callouts, glow

pieces.name: Replay screen
pieces.note: Track map, trail, scrubber, camera modes

pieces.name: Calibration flow
pieces.note: Mount guidance with live sensor feedback

log.text: Environment checked: Linux, no Swift toolchain and Swift downloads blocked; npm and PyPI reachable. Stack decided: Expo SDK 57 + TypeScript engine + Skia, verified via web build in Chromium.
Shared engine contracts written (types, unit conventions, frames). App-foundation agent launched.
Simulator producing 100 Hz phone-frame IMU + 1 Hz GPS with latency for two tracks; first plots inspected.
